schema.text: Without a car, which of these do you give up or find very hard? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Taking older relatives or people with walking difficulties out
Going with someone to medical or official appointments
Travelling at night or getting to night shifts
Reaching places with no direct public transport, for example work outside the ring road
Carrying heavy work tools or equipment
Getting around when public transport is on strike
Travelling to or from areas poorly served by public transport
Doing several errands in different places on the same day
Travelling with small children and their things (pushchair, bags)
Coming home at night without travelling alone on public transport
Taking animals to the vet or other places
Picking people up with luggage at a station or airport
Taking bulky or hazardous waste to a collection point
Making long trips where I must be sure of getting back
Making unexpected trips, even out of town

it.#Without a car, which of these do you gi: Senza auto, a cosa rinunci o cosa fai con molta fatica? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni applicabili)
it.#Taking older relatives or people with w: Portare fuori familiari anziani o persone con difficoltà a camminare
it.#Going with someone to medical or offici: Accompagnare qualcuno a visite mediche o appuntamenti ufficiali
it.#Travelling at night or getting to night: Spostarmi di notte o raggiungere i turni di notte
it.#Reaching places with no direct public t: Raggiungere posti senza collegamenti diretti con i mezzi pubblici, per esempio il lavoro fuori dal raccordo anulare
it.#Carrying heavy work tools or equipment: Portare attrezzi o attrezzature da lavoro pesanti
it.#Getting around when public transport is: Spostarmi quando i mezzi pubblici sono in sciopero
it.#Travelling to or from areas poorly serv: Andare o tornare da zone poco servite dai mezzi pubblici
it.#Doing several errands in different plac: Fare più commissioni in posti diversi nella stessa giornata
it.#Travelling with small children and thei: Spostarmi con bambini piccoli e le loro cose (passeggino, borse)
it.#Coming home at night without travelling: Tornare a casa di notte con qualcuno sui mezzi pubblici
it.#Taking animals to the vet or other plac: Portare animali dal veterinario o in altri posti
it.#Picking people up with luggage at a sta: Andare a prendere persone con i bagagli in stazione o in aeroporto
it.#Taking bulky or hazardous waste to a co: Portare rifiuti ingombranti o pericolosi a un punto di raccolta
it.#Making long trips where I must be sure: Fare viaggi lunghi in cui devo avere la certezza di tornare
it.#Making unexpected trips, even out of to: Fare spostamenti imprevisti, anche fuori città

fr.#Without a car, which of these do you gi: Sans voiture, à quoi renoncez-vous ou qu’est-ce qui vous est très difficile ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)
fr.#Taking older relatives or people with w: Emmener en sortie des proches âgés ou des personnes qui ont du mal à marcher
fr.#Going with someone to medical or offici: Accompagner quelqu’un à des rendez-vous médicaux ou administratifs
fr.#Travelling at night or getting to night: Me déplacer la nuit ou me rendre à un travail de nuit
fr.#Reaching places with no direct public t: Rejoindre des lieux sans transport en commun direct, par exemple un travail en dehors du périphérique
fr.#Carrying heavy work tools or equipment: Transporter des outils ou du matériel de travail lourds
fr.#Getting around when public transport is: Me déplacer en cas de grève des transports en commun
fr.#Travelling to or from areas poorly serv: Aller vers des zones mal desservies par les transports en commun ou en revenir
fr.#Doing several errands in different plac: Faire plusieurs courses à des endroits différents dans la même journée
fr.#Travelling with small children and thei: Voyager avec de jeunes enfants et leurs affaires (poussette, sacs)
fr.#Coming home at night without travelling: Rentrer la nuit sans devoir être seul ou seule dans les transports en commun
fr.#Taking animals to the vet or other plac: Emmener des animaux chez le vétérinaire ou ailleurs
fr.#Carrying bulky or fragile items: Transporter des objets encombrants ou fragiles
fr.#Picking people up with luggage at a sta: Aller chercher des personnes avec des bagages à une gare ou à un aéroport
fr.#Taking bulky or hazardous waste to a co: Apporter des déchets encombrants ou dangereux à un point de collecte
fr.#Making long trips where I must be sure: Faire de longs trajets pour lesquels je dois avoir la certitude de pouvoir rentrer
fr.#Making unexpected trips, even out of to: Faire des trajets imprévus, même hors de la ville

de.#Without a car, which of these do you gi: Worauf verzichten Sie ohne Auto oder was fällt Ihnen dann sehr schwer? (Wählen Sie alles Zutreffende aus)
de.#Taking older relatives or people with w: Ältere Angehörige oder Menschen mit Gehschwierigkeiten begleiten
de.#Going with someone to medical or offici: Jemanden zu Arzt- oder Behördenterminen begleiten
de.#Travelling at night or getting to night: Nachts unterwegs sein oder zur Nachtschicht kommen
de.#Reaching places with no direct public t: Orte ohne direkte Verbindung mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln erreichen, zum Beispiel einen Arbeitsplatz außerhalb des Autobahnrings
de.#Carrying heavy work tools or equipment: Schweres Arbeitswerkzeug oder schwere Ausrüstung transportieren
de.#Getting around when public transport is: Unterwegs sein, wenn im öffentlichen Verkehr gestreikt wird
de.#Travelling to or from areas poorly serv: In Gegenden fahren oder aus Gegenden kommen, die schlecht mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln erschlossen sind
de.#Doing several errands in different plac: Am selben Tag mehrere Erledigungen an verschiedenen Orten machen
de.#Travelling with small children and thei: Mit kleinen Kindern und ihren Sachen (Kinderwagen, Taschen) unterwegs sein
de.#Coming home at night without travelling: Nachts nach Hause kommen, ohne allein mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu fahren
de.#Taking animals to the vet or other plac: Tiere zum Tierarzt oder an andere Orte bringen
de.#Picking people up with luggage at a sta: Menschen mit Gepäck am Bahnhof oder Flughafen abholen
de.#Taking bulky or hazardous waste to a co: Sperrmüll oder Sondermüll zu einer Sammelstelle bringen
de.#Making long trips where I must be sure: Lange Fahrten machen, bei denen ich sicher sein muss, wieder zurückzukommen
de.#Making unexpected trips, even out of to: Unvorhergesehene Fahrten machen, auch außerhalb der Stadt

tr.#Without a car, which of these do you gi: Arabanız olmadan bunlardan hangilerinden vazgeçiyor veya hangilerini çok zor buluyorsunuz? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#Taking older relatives or people with w: Yaşlı akrabaları veya yürüme güçlüğü olan kişileri dışarı çıkarmak
tr.#Going with someone to medical or offici: Birine sağlık veya resmî randevularda eşlik etmek
tr.#Travelling at night or getting to night: Geceleri yolculuk etmek veya gece vardiyalarına gitmek
tr.#Reaching places with no direct public t: Doğrudan toplu taşıma olmayan yerlere, örneğin çevre yolunun dışındaki işe ulaşmak
tr.#Carrying heavy work tools or equipment: Ağır iş aletlerini veya ekipmanlarını taşımak
tr.#Travelling to or from areas poorly serv: Toplu taşımanın yetersiz olduğu bölgelere veya bölgelerden yolculuk etmek
tr.#Doing several errands in different plac: Aynı gün farklı yerlerde birkaç iş halletmek
tr.#Travelling with small children and thei: Küçük çocuklarla ve eşyalarıyla (bebek arabası, çantalar) yolculuk etmek
tr.#Coming home at night without travelling: Geceleri toplu taşımayla yalnız yolculuk etmeden eve dönmek
tr.#Taking animals to the vet or other plac: Hayvanları veterinere veya başka yerlere götürmek
tr.#Picking people up with luggage at a sta: Bir istasyondan veya havalimanından bagajlı kişileri almak
tr.#Taking bulky or hazardous waste to a co: Hacimli veya tehlikeli atıkları toplama noktasına götürmek
tr.#Making long trips where I must be sure: Geri dönebileceğimden emin olmam gereken uzun yolculuklar yapmak
tr.#Making unexpected trips, even out of to: Şehir dışı da dahil, beklenmedik yolculuklar yapmak

fa.#Without a car, which of these do you gi: بدون خودرو، کدام یک از این کارها را کنار می‌گذارید یا برایتان بسیار دشوار می‌شود؟ (همه گزینه‌های مربوط را انتخاب کنید)
fa.#Taking older relatives or people with w: بردن اعضای مسن خانواده یا افراد دارای مشکل در راه رفتن به بیرون
fa.#Going with someone to medical or offici: همراهی یک نفر در قرارهای پزشکی یا اداری
fa.#Travelling at night or getting to night: سفر در شب یا رفتن به شیفت شب
fa.#Reaching places with no direct public t: رسیدن به جاهایی که حمل‌ونقل عمومی مستقیم ندارند، مثلاً محل کار خارج از کمربندی
fa.#Carrying heavy work tools or equipment: حمل ابزار یا تجهیزات کاری سنگین
fa.#Travelling to or from areas poorly serv: سفر به مناطقی که حمل‌ونقل عمومی ضعیفی دارند، یا از آن مناطق
fa.#Doing several errands in different plac: انجام چند کار در جاهای مختلف در یک روز
fa.#Travelling with small children and thei: سفر با کودکان خردسال و وسایلشان (کالسکه، کیف)
fa.#Coming home at night without travelling: بازگشت شبانه به خانه بدون اینکه مجبور باشم تنها با حمل‌ونقل عمومی سفر کنم
fa.#Taking animals to the vet or other plac: بردن حیوانات به دامپزشک یا جاهای دیگر
fa.#Picking people up with luggage at a sta: رفتن به دنبال کسانی که با چمدان به ایستگاه یا فرودگاه می‌رسند
fa.#Taking bulky or hazardous waste to a co: بردن زباله‌های حجیم یا خطرناک به محل جمع‌آوری
fa.#Making long trips where I must be sure: سفرهای طولانی که باید از بازگشت مطمئن باشم
fa.#Making unexpected trips, even out of to: سفرهای پیش‌بینی‌نشده، حتی به خارج از شهر

hu.#Without a car, which of these do you gi: Autó nélkül melyekről mond le, vagy melyeket talál nagyon nehéznek? (Jelölje meg az összes megfelelőt)
hu.#Taking older relatives or people with w: Idős hozzátartozók vagy nehezen járó emberek elvitele
hu.#Going with someone to medical or offici: Valaki elkísérése orvosi vagy hivatalos ügyintézésre
hu.#Travelling at night or getting to night: Éjszakai utazás vagy éjszakai műszakba járás
hu.#Reaching places with no direct public t: Olyan helyek elérése, ahová nincs közvetlen tömegközlekedés, például a körgyűrűn kívüli munkahely
hu.#Travelling to or from areas poorly serv: Utazás a tömegközlekedéssel rosszul ellátott területekre vagy onnan
hu.#Doing several errands in different plac: Több ügy intézése ugyanazon a napon, különböző helyeken
hu.#Travelling with small children and thei: Utazás kisgyerekekkel és a holmijukkal (babakocsi, táskák)
hu.#Coming home at night without travelling: Éjszakai hazajutás anélkül, hogy egyedül kellene tömegközlekedéssel utaznom
hu.#Taking animals to the vet or other plac: Állatok elvitele az állatorvoshoz vagy máshová
hu.#Picking people up with luggage at a sta: Csomaggal érkezők felvétele az állomáson vagy a repülőtéren
hu.#Taking bulky or hazardous waste to a co: Terjedelmes vagy veszélyes hulladék gyűjtőhelyre vitele
hu.#Making long trips where I must be sure: Hosszú utak, amelyeknél biztosnak kell lennem abban, hogy haza tudok jutni
hu.#Making unexpected trips, even out of to: Váratlan utak, akár a városon kívülre is

ar.#Without a car, which of these do you gi: من دون سيارة، أي من هذه الأمور تتخلى عنها أو تجدها صعبة جدًا؟ (يمكن اختيار كل ما ينطبق)
ar.#Taking older relatives or people with w: اصطحاب كبار السن من الأقارب أو الأشخاص الذين يجدون صعوبة في المشي
ar.#Going with someone to medical or offici: مرافقة أحد إلى مواعيد طبية أو رسمية
ar.#Travelling at night or getting to night: التنقل ليلًا أو الوصول إلى نوبات العمل الليلية
ar.#Reaching places with no direct public t: الوصول إلى أماكن لا يوجد إليها نقل عام مباشر، مثل العمل خارج الطريق الدائري
ar.#Carrying heavy work tools or equipment: حمل أدوات أو معدات عمل ثقيلة
ar.#Travelling to or from areas poorly serv: التنقل من المناطق التي تخدمها وسائل النقل العام بشكل سيئ أو إليها
ar.#Doing several errands in different plac: قضاء عدة حاجات في أماكن مختلفة في اليوم نفسه
ar.#Travelling with small children and thei: التنقل مع أطفال صغار وأغراضهم (عربة أطفال، حقائب)
ar.#Coming home at night without travelling: العودة إلى البيت ليلًا دون ركوب وسائل النقل العام وحدك
ar.#Taking animals to the vet or other plac: نقل الحيوانات إلى الطبيب البيطري أو أماكن أخرى
ar.#Doing big grocery shopping: شراء كميات كبيرة من المواد الغذائية
ar.#Carrying bulky or fragile items: نقل أغراض كبيرة الحجم أو قابلة للكسر
ar.#Picking people up with luggage at a sta: استقبال أشخاص معهم حقائب في محطة أو مطار
ar.#Taking bulky or hazardous waste to a co: نقل نفايات كبيرة الحجم أو خطرة إلى نقطة تجميع
ar.#Making long trips where I must be sure: القيام برحلات طويلة أحتاج فيها إلى التأكد من العودة
ar.#Making unexpected trips, even out of to: القيام برحلات غير متوقعة، حتى خارج المدينة
